video_title: Golden Tate Thought Winning a Super Bowl Was EASY… Until He Left Seattle

quotes.speaker: Golden Tate
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden Tate on the pressure of being a first-round draft pick
quotes.excerpt: mentally I was not ready to be a first-rounder and the pressure that come with being
quotes.quote: The beginning of my career was like almost like a little fantasy. I got drafted in the second round, 60th overall pick. In my opinion, I thought I should have went in the first round, but mentally I was not ready to be a first-rounder and the pressure that come with being a first-rounder and expectations, I probably wouldn't have been able to handle it. So I am so grateful that Pete Carroll, who was coaching straight from SC, he left me to go with you. I'm still upset about that, Pete.

quotes.speaker: Golden Tate
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden Tate on his early struggles as a receiver
quotes.excerpt: I had to go through those growing pains and learn how to be a pro really
quotes.quote: I didn't produce on the field. I didn't really get too many opportunities to produce because I couldn't be trusted for many reasons. At that point, I'd only been playing receiver for three seasons because I was a running back and went into college, went over to receiver. So I had to learn everything about being a receiver because I was just an athlete out there running around. I had to go through those growing pains and learn how to be a pro really, and then it finally clicked.

quotes.speaker: Golden Tate
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden Tate on the atmosphere in Seattle during the tech boom
quotes.excerpt: Seattle loves their sports. So we're selling out every single game
quotes.quote: Being in Seattle was awesome. We were there during kind of the tech boom. The economy was starting to just boom back then. I was in Pacific Northwest with all this great seafood and Seattle loves their sports. So we're selling out every single game. Pete Carroll is super energetic, bringing in cool people to speak to us. Shooting basketballs before meetings, throwing the football from the 50-yard line into a hoop on the side trying to create one-hand catches. We are at that point, we are hands down in the toughest division in football.

quotes.speaker: Golden Tate
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden Tate on his strict pre-game routine and preparation
quotes.excerpt: One thing Pete Carroll said, don't make shit up. Stick to your routine
quotes.quote: I tried to stick to my routine. One thing Pete Carroll said, don't make shit up. Stick to your routine. If your routine is to go to dinner, have a glass of wine, just because Super Bowl, don't change that up. I did what I usually do. I go out to dinner, maybe have a beer or two, and then it's go time. I look over my playbook. One thing I did my entire career is that I wanted to make sure I always slept. Non-negotiable. My sleep before a game has to happen.
